name: Post-Quantum Migration
summary: Bitcoin's three-phase transition to post-quantum cryptography. Introduces Pay-to-Merkle-Root (P2MR, BIP-360) as a quantum-resistant output type without the vulnerable key-path spend, and BIP-361 plans a phased sunset of ECDSA/Schnorr signatures over 5 years.
summaryZh: 比特币向抗量子密码学的三阶段过渡。引入 Pay-to-Merkle-Root（P2MR，BIP-360）作为移除脆弱密钥路径花费的抗量子输出类型，BIP-361 规划在5年内分阶段淘汰 ECDSA/Schnorr 签名。
